title: Promise completion wake should suppress stale follow-up after explicit wait
wanted_capability: When an agent explicitly waits for a shell promise and receives its terminal result, the harness should either suppress the later auto-injected HARNESS_EVENT for that promise or mark it as already consumed with no misleading next-step instruction. The auto-wake should not tell the agent to call promise_status after the terminal result is already in context.
fallback_used: Ignored the redundant HARNESS_EVENT after promise_wait had already returned the completed shell result.
evidence: session: shell_run promise pr-1 followed by promise_wait terminal result, then HARNESS_EVENT still instructed promise_status
resolution_note: Implemented in bro-tools promise lifecycle: terminal promise_wait / promise_when_all / promise_when_any now mark the relevant completion wake(s) delivered before returning terminal snapshots, so later drain_completion_events does not inject stale HARNESS_EVENTs. Added tests for status preserving wake, timeout preserving wake, and terminal wait consuming wake.
